name: 1Password
author: Prism
description: Search your 1Password items, paste passwords and one-time passwords, and generate new passwords, through the 1Password CLI.

preferences.title: Paste on Return
preferences.caption: Return pastes a login’s password into the app you opened Prism over. When off, Return copies it, and ⌘⇧V pastes.

preferences.title: 1Password CLI Path
preferences.caption: Leave blank to find op in your PATH, /usr/local/bin, or /opt/homebrew/bin.

zh-Hans.name: 1Password
zh-Hans.description: 通过 1Password CLI 搜索你的 1Password 项目，粘贴密码和一次性密码，并生成新密码。

returnPastes.title: 按 Return 键粘贴
returnPastes.caption: 按 Return 键会把登录项的密码粘贴到你打开 Prism 前所在的 App。关闭后，Return 键改为拷贝，⌘⇧V 粘贴。

cliPath.title: 1Password CLI 路径
cliPath.caption: 留空则在 PATH、/usr/local/bin 或 /opt/homebrew/bin 中查找 op。

zh-Hant.name: 1Password
zh-Hant.description: 透過 1Password CLI 搜尋你的 1Password 項目，貼上密碼和一次性密碼，並產生新密碼。

returnPastes.title: 按 Return 鍵貼上
returnPastes.caption: 按 Return 鍵會把登入項目的密碼貼上到你打開 Prism 前所在的 App。關閉後，Return 鍵改為拷貝，⌘⇧V 貼上。

cliPath.title: 1Password CLI 路徑
cliPath.caption: 留空則在 PATH、/usr/local/bin 或 /opt/homebrew/bin 中尋找 op。
